member.name: MarkdownScrollChaining.AttachViewer
member.summary: Attaches wheel routing to a rendered viewer or plain-text fallback viewer according to the options: nothing when wheel chaining is disabled, pass-through when the content cannot scroll, and full routing otherwise.
member.param: The rendering options that select the behavior.

member.name: MarkdownScrollChaining.AttachCodeBlock
member.summary: Attaches wheel routing to a code-block editor. A code-block editor hosted without the rendered viewer scrolls itself and forwards an unconsumable wheel to its parent; inside the viewer, the viewer's handler routes the wheel to the editor first. Nothing is attached when wheel chaining or scrolling is disabled.
member.param: The code-block editor to attach to.
The rendering options that select the behavior.
